title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 95
paragraphs: Of this Euenios, I say, Deïphonos was the son, and he was acting as diviner for the army, having been brought by the Corinthians. I have heard, however, that Deïphonos was wrongly making use of Euenios's name and undertook work of this kind around Greece, not being really the son of Euenios.
